chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning Crushes Young Master Yunpeng’s Pride with a Pure Yang Arrow – Desolate Era Ch 402
chapter_meta_description: Young Master Yunpeng tries to humiliate Ji Ning at Heavenly Treasures Mountain. Then Ji Ning casually produces a single Fire Elephant Arrow worth an entire Pure Yang treasure. Xiyue’s ruthless clan-rebuilding strategy is also revealed.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch 402 – A Single Arrow’s Worth
og_description: Ji Ning completely demolishes Young Master Yunpeng’s arrogance by paying for a fortress-forming array with a single Pure Yang-grade arrow. Xiyue’s cold pragmatism for rebuilding the Yuchi clan also comes to light.
twitter_title: Desolate Era Ch 402: The Arrow That Broke a Noble’s Pride
twitter_description: Yunpeng tried to flex. Ji Ning pulled out a Pure Yang arrow. It was not even close. Also, Xiyue reveals her ruthless 5D chess for rebuilding her fallen clan.

lore_anchors.definition: An arrow fired from the Luohou Bow, each one equivalent in value to a low-grade Pure Yang treasure. Divine archers of the Three Realms must have specially crafted arrows that can survive being shot from legendary bows, making each arrow a disposable top-tier weapon.

The highest tier of manufactured treasures in the Three Realms, above even supreme-grade Immortal treasures. They cannot be purchased with Primordial Liquid alone and are typically traded for other Pure Yang or high-grade treasures.

A proud noble from the Windstop Isle of the Heavenly Realm, pursuing Yuchi Xiyue. He is arrogant, wealthy, and uses his resources to flaunt status, making him a prime target for social humiliation in this chapter.

The Xiyue Commandery Princess, Ji Ning's cousin, and the heir of the fallen Yuchi clan. She is coldly pragmatic, willing to tolerate a wealthy suitor's arrogance purely to extract resources for rebuilding her clan.
A supreme-grade innate spirit treasure obtained by Ji Ning from the Divine Fiend corpse in Chiya Mountain. It is a legendary bow of the Three Realms, and its arrows are Pure Yang-level artifacts.
The white-robed female immortal in charge of high-end transactions at Heavenly Treasures Mountain's headquarters, deferring to her Celestial Immortal ancestor for major deals.
The largest treasure-trading organization in the Grand Xia Dynasty, backed by the imperial Xiamang clan. Its headquarters in the capital can handle even Celestial Immortal-level transactions.

The supreme divine ability beneath the True God level, trained by mastering nine cycles of body refinement. It requires enormous treasure resources (such as Immortal pills) to advance, which is why Primordial Liquid alone is insufficient for Ji Ning's cultivation.
A treasure born from primordial natural forces, possessing a spiritual nature; it can choose its own master and is harder to refine than manufactured treasures.
